text:
The content is mostly accurate. The 10% speed gain, the error rates, the 17% gain for new staff, the 64% preference, the $210,000 cost and the 14-month payback all match the source. "Levelled off within four weeks" is a slight simplification of "most of the gain came in the first four weeks."

The response breaks the explicit "under 120 words" limit. I count about 200 words, and the staff-view bullet alone brings the running total past 120. It also wastes words on filler: "This summary sets out the main results…", "The key findings are listed below," and "It is worth keeping this limitation in mind when reading the findings above." The takeaway adds a mild recommendation ("worth considering") that the source does not strongly make. The response keeps the right points but ignores the main constraint a busy manager needs.

Score: 3
